title: Session policy
description: Schema for governance/policies/session-policy.yaml, the rules and the kickoff prompt templates that governance session applies (ADR-0030). The tool checks more than this schema can express: every rule must be reachable, every combination of facts must match a rule, and every placeholder of a prompt must exist.

rules.description: Evaluated in order. The first rule whose conditions all hold decides the advice. The last rule has no conditions, so every case has an answer.

prompts.description: One kickoff prompt template for each kind of task. A placeholder is a lowercase word in braces that the tool fills from status.yaml.

conditions.description: Each condition names one fact and the one value it must have. A condition that is not listed matches any value.
